quirks: Backend #0 (POST https://orbisapi.com/proxy/content-moderation-api-4fa8a6) is DEAD: x402 charge settles on Base (~$0.0035) but upstream returns HTTP 404 HTML 'Cannot POST /content-moderation/'. Money lost, no result.

Backend #1 (.../content-moderation-api-4fa8a6/:endpoint) charges PER PATH ($0.005) and every path is 402-paywalled — there is no free discovery. The root/empty :endpoint returns only a service-index JSON {name,info,openapi,health}, NOT a moderation result.
The proxy PREPENDS upstream base path /content-moderation/ to :endpoint, so :endpoint=openapi.json -> /content-moderation/openapi.json. Do NOT include /content-moderation/ yourself.

The actual moderation route name was NOT discoverable from registry data or 402 metadata within the test budget; the openapi.json could not be fetched cleanly. Phase A and Phase B even disagreed on the method (GET vs POST), confirming the doc is not usable as-is.
Phase B verification FAILED: a blind agent could not produce a working moderation call from the doc, and spent $0.015 exploring.

salvage.plan: If we want to recover this service: budget ~$0.03, GET :endpoint=info first to read the API's own route list, then call the documented moderation route with text as a query param.
